deployment_requirement.statement: A document type, a decision that rests on it and the cost of a wrong reading, declared by its owner.

external_referent: A public labelled corpus and a scanned-document set with ground-truth text; an independent replication.

robustness.question: Does the model hold up when the text is degraded?
robustness.perturbation_or_signal: Character noise at OCR-like rates; paraphrase; truncation to half length.
robustness.truth: The clean text and its label.
robustness.metric: Macro F1 on perturbed text against clean; character error rate of the OCR step against ground truth.
robustness.acceptance_rule: Macro F1 drop <= f1_drop_ceiling at each level and character error rate <= cer_ceiling.

drift.question: Is a change in vocabulary or topic noticed?
drift.perturbation_or_signal: A planted topic mix change and a new document template.
drift.metric: Detection rate on out-of-vocabulary share and embedding distance; false alarms per 1000 null batches.
drift.acceptance_rule: Detection rate >= detect_floor and false alarms <= alarm_ceiling.

explanation.question: Are cited passages the ones that support the answer?
explanation.perturbation_or_signal: Documents with a planted supporting passage.
explanation.metric: Share of predictions whose cited span contains the planted passage; deletion test on the cited span.
explanation.acceptance_rule: Citation grounding >= grounding_floor and the prediction changes when the cited span is deleted in >= deletion_floor of cases.

monitoring.question: Can reading quality be watched in production?
monitoring.perturbation_or_signal: Streams with degraded scans at a known batch.
monitoring.truth: The batch at which scan quality fell.
monitoring.metric: Detection delay for OCR confidence and out-of-vocabulary share.

parameter_rule: Every null parameter is fixed by the deployment owner and written into this file before the first line of the slice is built; it is never fitted to a result.
not_claimed: any benchmark in this file has been run
a baseline linear classifier on bag-of-words features is a qualified NLP system
